C1549.title: Economics of NFTs: The value of creator royalties
C1549.summary: The arXiv preprint Economics of NFTs: The value of creator royalties analyzes the economic value of NFT creator royalties under real-world market frictions. The paper states that creator royalties can create value through mechanisms such as risk sharing, mitigating information asymmetry, and price discrimination benefits. The current references better support NFT royalty economics research and should not be framed as a royalty bypass case unless sources about royalty avoidance are added.
